first_burn_request.detail: Landing attitude and up to three main engines requested; actual ignition remains alignment-gated.

rejected_powered_alignment.basis: Intermediate v4 working tree over c13539c4; full source hashes retained. Exact patch also contains the non-dynamic hold timer field.

limits: Fixture decisions; no new Jev or DeepSeek call, physical spacecraft execution or AI advantage.
Hold fixtures have unchanged terminal metrics but fail the normal no-intervention comparator because the injected hold is unnecessary.
The explicit hold plus absent reassessment reply stops release at 30 seconds; retained return is not qualified safe recovery.
Ship and booster clocks are integrated sequentially, not concurrent flight control.
Powered-alignment probes initialize changed separation fuel; they are not fresh launch comparisons or held-out qualification.
All three powered-alignment candidates fail entry and consume all propellant; their controller change is not shipped.
The original controller and declared goal remain unchanged; nominal model entry does not establish robust recovery.
All five final runs use the final source snapshot. Earlier pre-review runs remain historical local records.
A separate review-fix batch changed source while running and is excluded; its partial checkpoints and errors are preserved locally.
Verdict canonical input digests and named source fingerprints bind inputs; they are not signatures or loaded-code execution attestation.
The105s hold guard has no integration/post-dispatch observation margin; return-adjacent double-timeout schedules are not qualified.
First deployment decisions at or after return can raise invalid_decision_deadline; late release starts are not qualified.
Invalid verdicts omit canonical study digest; bind them with raw input byte hashes/manifests and expected run identity.
